description.en: Application ID. You can create and query it in the console. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh: 已存在的频道ID，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: An existing channel ID. Only a single ID is supported.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于服务端主动关闭在线频道。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used by the server to actively shut down an online channel.  
### queries per second (QPS) Limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your service. Invoke this API appropriately.
